historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_5yr_cagr (FY2020-FY2025), rounded; equity CAGR is not usable as the anchor because the ~100% payout policy suppresses retained earnings
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5y CAGR 7.1% vs owner-FCF 5y CAGR -5.9% and EPS 5y CAGR -0.5%: diverges by more than 30%. FY2020 was a COVID stock-up peak (revenue +25%, FCF RMB843m) and FY2021 a trough (FCF RMB164m on capacity capex); the revenue series is the only one that describes the trend. Owner-FCF CAGR is below reported-FCF CAGR because interest income rose (RMB20m -> RMB42m, peaking at RMB75m in FY2024), not because of SBC.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income, RMBm): FY2020 843.0, FY2021 163.8, FY2022 824.6, FY2023 584.2, FY2024 584.5, FY2025 622.4. FY2025 OCF was depressed by a working-capital build (inventory days 34.0 -> 40.5); H1 FY2026 OCF RMB393m vs RMB257m a year earlier as it partly unwound. H1 FY2026 revenue +14.3%, net profit +20.3%, gross margin 33.6% (+4.1pp).

scenario_narratives.base: The 2027-29 Master Purchase Agreement with Haidilao/Super Hi/Shuhai is renewed on broadly current terms (same controlling family on both sides, HKEX 14A annual caps reset) and related-party sales track Haidilao's flat-to-slightly-negative same-store trend, while third-party B-end (+73% FY2025), overseas (+45%) and e-commerce channels carry group growth from 11% in FY2026 down to 3% by FY2033. EBITDA margin settles at 23%: the raw-material (cooking oil, beef tallow) tailwind that lifted gross margin to 33.6% is partly given back to channel mix and distribution spend. Capex eases from 4.2% to 3.5% of revenue as the Malaysia/overseas capacity build completes, and the ~100% payout continues on a net-cash balance sheet.
scenario_narratives.bull: Both engines fire: Haidilao's franchising and new-format push stabilises related-party volumes while the 'two-direct' KA model, B-end customisation and overseas direct sales (Singapore/Malaysia/Thailand) compound third-party revenue at double digits for three years (14%/10%/9%). Mix shift to dipping sauces, solid tallow and spices plus automation and AI-driven supply-chain efficiency lift EBITDA margin to 25% by FY2031. Terminal growth 3.0%; the 16x cap binds, so no multiple expansion beyond today's is assumed.
scenario_narratives.bear: The successor MPA from 1 Jan 2027 is renewed at lower annual caps and tighter pricing (or Haidilao shifts part of its soup-base supply to Shuhai in-house / third-party suppliers): related-party revenue (~28-30% of group) falls ~25% in FY2027, only partly offset by third-party growth, for a -6% group year and a flat FY2028. Pricing concessions and a reversal of the edible-oil cost tailwind compress EBITDA margin to 19.5%, Tianwei's HK listing intensifies C-end competition, and growth settles at 2% with terminal growth 1.5%. Net cash and zero debt mean there is no solvency path; the bear case is a lower earnings base, not distress.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A net-cash, debt-free consumer-staples manufacturer paying out ~100% of earnings, valued on fully attributable owner FCF in RMB and bridged to HKD. The value question is almost entirely about the durability of the Haidilao-linked revenue stream after the 2026 MPA expiry and whether the third-party channels can keep diversifying it; margin and capex are comparatively stable. Risk is carried in the scenarios and their weights, not in the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: Successor Master Purchase Agreement for 2027 onward not yet confirmed; renewal terms (caps, pricing) set ~30% of revenue
Haidilao same-store sales and table turnover declining (H1 2026 revenue -3.7%, profit -14%)
Raw-material cost tailwind (edible oil, beef tallow) is commodity-cycle dependent and could reverse the 4pp gross-margin gain
Tianwei Food HK listing sharpens C-end competition and capital-market comparison
Governance: controlling family on both sides of the related-party channel; pricing fairness relies on HKEX 14A review
FX: RMB flows against an HKD quote; a 5% CNY move shifts the HKD value ~5%
Interim dividend (~HK$0.42/share) declared but not yet out of the 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 11.83-17.33 HKD
data_sources.financials: 1579.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, FY2017-FY2025 annual and H1 FY2023-FY2026 interim); H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet, cash flow, note 21 EPS) for the 30 Jun 2026 anchors; FY2025 annual report for cash tax, ROU depreciation, other income and the no-borrowings statement

inputs.share_count_basis: 970.132m = weighted average shares in issue less ~66.6m shares held by the RSU/share-scheme trustee (H1 FY2026 interim, note 21). Issued shares are ~1,036.7m (10% scheme mandate = 103.67m) but trustee-held shares receive no dividends and carry no economic claim until awarded; diluted = basic because there were no unvested awards at 30 Jun 2026. Held FLAT: SBC is nil, and any future awards from the trustee pool would be an SBC charge, not new issuance.
inputs.cash_note: 30 Jun 2026: cash and cash equivalents RMB1,750.420m + financial assets at FVTPL (bank wealth-management products, churned ~RMB4.2bn per half) RMB397.443m. Excludes restricted cash RMB5.0m and other financial assets at amortised cost RMB15.8m. Term deposits nil. Zero bank borrowings (FY2025 AR p.1697). Lease liabilities RMB109.7m are NOT in net debt (lease treatment B). The HK$0.4188/share FY2026 interim dividend (~RMB346m) declared with the H1 results is paid in H2 2026 and is not yet out of this balance sheet; if the shares are already ex-dividend, net cash per share is overstated by ~HK$0.42.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash-flow statement: share-based payment expense nil (last material charge FY2019 RMB37.5m; FY2024 RMB1.4m). Equity-award taxes nil. 2026 Share Award Scheme adopted 27 Jan 2026 with no grants in H1 FY2026.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases in FY2024, FY2025 or H1 FY2026 (last: RMB175.8m in H1 FY2023). Flat count is a convention the company is not currently paying for, but SBC is also nil so there is nothing to offset.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1726, Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16. Cross-check: USDCNY ~6.65 / USDHKD ~7.80 -> 1.173. No dual listing exists for a parity check. All flows and per-share values are computed in RMB, then converted to HKD at this rate for the unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv so they compare to the HKD price.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + 1.0 beta x 7.2% ERP (6.0% mature-market ERP + ~1.2% China country premium) = 9.0% cost of equity; no debt, so WACC = cost of equity. Related-party concentration and governance risk are charged ONCE, in the scenario design and the 30% bear weight, not as a WACC premium, and the same 9.0% is used in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: cash lease payments (principal + interest, RMB10.6m in H1 FY2026, ~RMB21m/yr = 0.32% of revenue) deducted inside the flows via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB109.7m) excluded from net debt; D&A for cash-tax EBIT is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 total D&A RMB229.8m less ROU depreciation RMB36.5m = RMB193.3m = 2.9% of revenue). ROU assets (RMB266m) exceed lease liabilities because they include prepaid PRC land-use rights, whose amortisation is not a cash lease cost.
inputs.nci_treatment: Attributable-only flows: NCI (RMB121.5m book, ~5.3% of group profit: RMB49.5m FY2025, RMB20.4m H1 FY2026) folded into the cash_tax_rate_path as ~4pp of leakage (5.3% x (1 - 29%)), on top of a 29% cash tax rate (FY2025 cash tax RMB364.0m / PBT RMB1,275.4m = 28.5%; H1 FY2026 tax expense 29.7%; the rate exceeds the 25% PRC statutory because ~100% payout triggers dividend withholding tax). No NCI deduction in the bridge. Calibration: FY2025 EBIT RMB1,237.7m x (1 - 0.33) = RMB829m vs attributable NI RMB854.0m less after-tax finance income ~RMB27m = RMB827m.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing table: non-US operating company, consumer staples manufacturer) with the owner-fcf-adaptations: CNY-built WACC, lease treatment B, NCI via leakage, SBC-zero market (house and street coincide; band_position null), and the CNY/HKD bridge. Interest income (RMB42.3m FY2025) stripped from the FCF base because net cash (RMB2.15bn) is ~3.5x owner FCF; the matching assets (cash + FVTPL wealth-management products) sit in the bridge. The FV gains on those products and government grants sit in 'other income and gains' (RMB136.0m FY2025, RMB17.1m H1 FY2026), which is inside reported EBITDA; the forward margin path is anchored ~1pp below the FY2025 headline for that reason. EBITDA here is post-IFRS-16 (PBT - net finance income + total D&A), hence the explicit lease-cost line. Working capital: manufacturer with inventory + receivables (RMB715m) > payables + contract liabilities (RMB367m), so growth consumes cash (wc_capture -5% of the revenue change). Fresh build, first valuation of this ticker.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +11%: H1 +14.3% on a soft base, H2 comps harder (FY2025 was +1.1%, sell-side ~14%). FY2027 +7% assumes the Haidilao/Super Hi Master Purchase Agreement is renewed for 2027-29 on broadly current terms, as it has been at every three-year renewal since the 2016 IPO, with related-party sales flat-to-low-single-digit and third-party (B-end, overseas, e-commerce) carrying growth. Decelerates to 3% by year 8, consistent with the 4.3% 5y revenue CAGR and a maturing domestic condiment market.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 EBITDA 22.2% included RMB136m of other income/gains (2.1% of revenue); H1 FY2026 operating margin 16.4% (vs 14.7%) with only RMB17m of other income and the seasonally stronger H2 to come. 23% holds the raw-material tailwind (GM 33.6%) partly offset by mix shift toward lower-margin B-end/overseas third-party channels and continued distribution spend. Capex 4.2% -> 3.5% (FY2023-25 range 3.9-4.9%, H1 FY2026 annualised 3.8%) converging toward D&A ~3.0%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 16x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30% because ~28-30% of revenue depends on a single related-party group whose framework agreement expires 31 Dec 2026 with no public successor yet, and whose own same-store sales are falling; that is the single-customer dependency the method names explicitly. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right at once: related-party recovery, sustained double-digit third-party growth, and the commodity-cost tailwind persisting. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
